title: Seeing but Not Thinking: Routing Distraction in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2604.08541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have achieved remarkable performance on vision-language tasks. However, we identify a puzzling phenomenon termed Seeing but Not Thinking: models accurately perceive image content yet fail in subsequent reasoning, while correctly solving identical problems presented as pure text. Through systematic analysis, we first verify that cross-modal semantic sharing exists in MoE architectures, ruling out semantic alignment failure as the sole explanation. We then reveal that visual experts and domain experts exhibit layer-wise separation, with image inputs inducing significant routing divergence from text inputs in middle layers where domain experts concentrate. Based on these findings, we propose the Routing Distraction hypothesis: when processing visual inputs, the routing mechanism fails to adequately activate task-relevant reasoning experts. translated_title: 看见却未思考：多模态混合专家模型中的路由分心现象
translated_abstract: 多模态混合专家（MoE）模型在视觉-语言任务上取得了卓越的性能。然而，我们发现了一种令人困惑的现象，称之为“看见却未思考”：模型能够准确感知图像内容，却在后续推理中失败，而面对以纯文本形式呈现的相同问题却能正确解答。通过系统性分析，我们首先验证了MoE架构中存在跨模态语义共享，从而排除了语义对齐失败是唯一解释的可能性。随后，我们揭示了视觉专家与领域专家在层级上呈现分离分布，图像输入会在领域专家集中的中间层引发与文本输入显著不同的路由分歧。基于这些发现，我们提出了“路由分心”假设：在处理视觉输入时，路由机制未能充分激活与任务相关的推理专家。为验证该假设，我们设计了一种路由（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现多模态MoE模型存在“看见却未思考”现象——模型能准确感知图像却推理失败，并提出“路由分心”假设：视觉输入使路由机制偏离、未能充分激活任务相关的推理专家，从而解释了感知与推理之间的断裂。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "Seeing but Not Thinking" phenomenon in multimodal MoE models—accurate visual perception followed by failed reasoning—and proposes the Routing Distraction hypothesis, showing that visual inputs divert the routing mechanism away from adequately activating task-relevant reasoning experts.
